I also have manure from my cattle that I will spread here to help the soil, since this plot is intercropped and needs good fertility. We rely on the rains in this area, so I cannot irrigate, and my family will do most of the labor, though I will need to hire a few extra workers when the weeding and harvest come. I do not have money for pesticides or herbicides this season, so we will manage weeds by hand.
